profile.headline: Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary: Focused on participating in great engineering. Currently, obsessed with Functional Programming and instrumenting systems. Leveraging the compiler for correctness and data for improvement.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
TST builds and manages a custom white-label solution for travel agencies. If offers booking and search services for any travel type: air, car, hotel, cruise and tours. 

Scala Developer
•	Maintain back-end batch processing system – migrated to kubernetes.
•	Research and prototype stream pipelines for batch replacement.
•	Built and deployed prototype Ethereum contract

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend development using Scala. A micro-service architecture to provide all access to user data across all platforms.

•	Build backend data micro-services to share personal data across all platforms.
•	Built integrated test-suite with Postman, controlled by an sbt-plugin.
•	Migrated build system to Jenkins pipeline
•	Create load testing scenarios for application services.

positions.title: C# Developer
positions.description: C# programming for a variety of systems and platforms, including micro frameworks for custom device controllers, backend and web programming.

positions.title: Senior System Engineer
positions.description:
Rentpath is a web development company that connects consumers to apartments, rental properties and homes.  The applications are Ruby on Rails, Java and .NET, with mobile agents using RESTful services and data applications that are SQL, NoSQL and search (Endeca and Solr). 

Sr. Operations Architect
•	Primarily responsible for system design and building and prototyping tools.
•	Create platform strategy to simplify deployments and improve application monitoring and configuration.

positions.title: Performance Architect
positions.description:
Responsible for performance and application/infrastructure design for top 25 website.
      ·     Troubleshoot all production problems.
      ·     Develop and improve caching strategies and implementation for service and data systems.
      ·     Develop and implement build and deployment processes.
      ·     Evaluate virtualization and management systems.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaing production and development environments for custom applications for top 25 website.
      ·     Production environment is an active-active configuration across three datacenters.
      ·     Create internal or external development environments that are replicas of production.
      ·     Assist with design and configuration of monitoring environments.
      ·     Manage build and deployment processes for custom applications.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Primedia is a web development company that connects consumers to apartments, rental properties and homes.
The applications are Ruby on Rails, Java and .NET.
Linux Systems Administrator
      ·     Maintain, support and optimize environment of 200+ linux systems in a tiered architecture, running
            active-active in two data centers.
      ·     Configure and support MySQL clusters, with multi-master replication within and between data centers.
      ·     Configure and support 14 Big IP F5 LTM load balancers.
      ·     Manage and extend deployment processes for 10 production applications.
      ·     Manage and support an externally hosted PCI-compliant web site.
      ·     Manage and support backend processing jobs and updates to production databases.
Projects and Achievement Highlights:
      ·     Automated rebuild of production environment for migration from CentOS 5.2 to 5.5. The automated
            process built systems from bare-metal to serving requests in production without intervention.
      ·     Created configuration and deployment process for Jetty and Solr from lab to production.
      ·     Worked with development teams to migrate six applications from active-passive configuration between
            data centers to active-active.
      ·     Setup and configured Spacewalk server for kickstart and configuration management.

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description:
2009 ­ February 2010
TeleTech is a global business process outsourcing company. The company has many service offerings, primarily focused on building and maintaining call centers. Particularly focused on virtual call centers with all evaluations and performance assessment based on Six Sigma practices.
Technical Support
    ·   Provide technical assictance in high-volume call-center for a wide range of problems in Windows and Linux environments.
    ·   Implementing solutions or appropriately escalating problems under tight time constraints.
    ·   Provide troubleshooting assistance to co-workers.
Projects and Achievement Highlights:
    ·   Consistently ranked in top 10% of technical specialists, on team of ~120.
    ·   Was part of a team to review effectiveness of performance evaluation practices.
    ·   Participated in all opportunities for professional training.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
2007 ­ April 2009
Micro Consutants is a small IT outsourcing company that services primarily architect, engineering, construction and real-estate development companies. Services were focused on configuration, deployment, migration, and support of whitebox, SuperMicro and Dell server environments.
    ·   Testing and deployment of new systems configurations for linux storage, backup and application
        deployments.
    ·   Develop fully automated build processes specific to customer configuration for linux servers.
    ·   Write technical documentation for linux system design and configuration.
    ·   Maintained internal linux and Windows production servers.

Projects and Achievement Highlights:
    ·   Part of team designing and testing AoE (ATA over Ethernet) Linux SAN solutions.
    ·   Assisted in building and testing disaster recovery solutions.
    ·   Assisted in planning and relocation of data center equipment for corporate relocations.
    ·   Created scripts for deployment / re-deployment of applications by end-user from a web interface.
